data.name: Muhsinah
data.gender_notes: Muhsinah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muhsinah is a name that signifies a person who does good deeds and charitable acts. It is derived from the Arabic word 'muhsin', which means 'one who does good' or 'one who is charitable'. The name Muhsinah carries the meaning “Doer of good deeds” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhsinah usually hope their child will grow to embody doer of good deeds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Al-Muhsin (The Doer of Good) is one of the names of Allah, signifying His attribute of being the ultimate doer of good. A person with this name is believed to carry these divine qualities.
data.etymology: Muhsinah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Doer of good deeds.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhsinah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مُحسِنَة
in_arabic.meaning: أرملة من أهل الذكر، تُعتبر مُحسِنَةً
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُحسِنَةُ: الَّتِي تَحسِنُ، تَجودُ، تُبَسطُ، تُطيبُ، تَنسَجُ، تَستَنسِجُ. وَتَكَفُّلُ الأَمرِ بِحُسْنِ المَخيلةِ وَالطُلى وَالأَسلوبِ. وفي الصِفَةِ تُحسِنُ المُعتَرَفينَ في حِفظِ المَوعِظاتِ وَبَذلِ الخُطوبِ. وَتُعتَبَرُ مُحسِنَةً الَّتِي تَحسِنُ المَعاشِرةَ وَالتَعاطُفَ بَينَ الأَزواجِ وَبَينَ الأَولادِ وَبَينَ الأَحِبَّةِ

in_urdu.name: مُحسِنہ
in_urdu.meaning: مَحسِنہ کا مطلب ہے اچھی نیکو کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُحسِنہ کے معنی ہیں نیکو کرنے والی، اچھی، لطیف، خوش نما اور خوبصورت۔ اس نام کا تعلق بھی عرب زبان کی بہترین صفت محسِن سے ہے جو کہ اچھائی اور نیکی کے معنی میں آتی ہے۔
